concepts.meaning: An owned typed input snapshot captured before forward effects, also the process-local scope identity of result slots.
A normalized returned value tied to one captured input, step occurrence and action; not independent proof of commit.
Pure typed evaluation of already checked bindings within their available result prefix.
Owned occurrence/payload/time-input data before Event construction; clock-generated time remains uncalled.
Exact typed argument values for an occurrence, separate from recovery plan eligibility and external execution.

distinctions: captured input identity versus Workflow source identity
structural normalization versus business invariant execution
